messages:
maria_pm: Quick planning thread - customer request: offer 'representative exports' for SOC2 audits (they want configurable sampling + on-demand full retrieval). need scope, launch checklist, and top risks.
ajay_sec: Core constraint: sampled output must be cryptographically auditable. we should publish a manifest with seed, algorithm, and per-file checksums. BYOK customers complicate key wrapping.
dani_eng: two sampling modes to design: random-percent and stratified (by event_type, severity). stratified increases complexity but improves representativeness for audits.
sam_cs: customer feedback: prefer default 10% random, but ability to bump to 25% for higher assurance. they also want request flow for full export when auditors ask.
rebecca_ops: operational notes: exports can be generated nightly and stored in cold archive. full rehydrate on legal hold will incur compute and egress costs; realistic ETA is 36-72h depending on volume. need budget guardrails.
oliver_legal: legal must ensure sampling can't be used to avoid discovery obligations. contract language: sampled exports for routine audits; legal hold supersedes sampling and requires full-data production per SLA.
maria_pm: MVP proposal: API + UI to configure sample_pct & stratification, nightly sampled export pipeline, manifest generation, BYOK-aware encryption of manifests, legal-hold rehydrate workflow (manual kickoff), and customer-facing docs.
ajay_sec: manifest spec detail: fields = manifest_id, tenant_id, timestamp, sampling_mode, seed (HMAC-based), algorithm_version, chunk_hashes[], signature. Signatures stored with integrity store protected by KMS.
dani_eng: BYOK flow: manifests encrypted with tenant KEK; we also store a derived public verification blob so post-rotation verification remains possible. need design doc for key lifecycle.
sam_cs: customers will ask for proof sampling was not tampered with. provide a reproducibility tool: given seed + algorithm + original log index, they can reproduce selection. ship verifier CLI for auditors.
rebecca_ops: monitoring: track export job durations, output sizes, and rehydrate queue depth. alert if exports > X TB/month. add a billing flag for on-demand retrieval.
oliver_legal: require preservation toggle per-tenant to pause deletions (legal-hold flag). add audit log entries for hold creation and release.
ajay_sec: acceptance criteria: (1) manifests include verifiable seed and signature; (2) verifier tool reproduces selection; (3) manifests encrypted for BYOK tenants without losing verifiability; (4) legal-hold rehydrate test with SLA measurement (end-to-end).
maria_pm: dev estimate: sampling engine + manifest store = 2.5 sprints; BYOK manifest encryption + verification = 1.5 sprints; UI + docs + ops playbook = 1 sprint. need 3 engineers + 1 security lead part-time.
sam_cs: recommend pilot with 2 enterprise customers under NDA to validate assumptions and surface edge cases.
rebecca_ops: ops runbook items: job prioritization, cost-estimates sheet, dry-run endpoint for customers, and incident runbook if manifest verification fails.
oliver_legal: question: what happens if customer's key is lost? propose escrow option or retain a hashed, public verification token that doesn't expose plaintext. need legal review.
dani_eng: implementation note: use deterministic PRNG seeded with tenant_id + date + KDF secret (rotatable) to generate selections. store seed in manifest.
maria_pm: risks + mitigations: 1) Sales confusion between "sampled" and "full" -> update sales docs + contract clauses; 2) BYOK edge-cases -> escrow option & public verification token; 3) Cost/ETA disputes on rehydration -> publish SLAs and fee schedule.
sam_cs: action items: ajay -> manifest crypto spec; dani -> architecture draft and perf estimate; oliver -> contract/legal-hold wording; rebecca -> ops playbook + SLA draft; maria -> pilot customer outreach.
evidence-bot: simulated export job id=99817 started tenant=globex sample_pct=10 seed=0x9b4f2a manifest=mf-20240622-99817 :white_check_mark:
maria_pm: target pilot in 6 weeks. will coordinate with sales and legal. thanks team! :rocket:
